_note: The sibling of s1-4-4-of-7 — same panel, every step done. Read that
recipe's note for the type-scale and DS-Checkbox moves and for why the
checklist CARD (296:2032) is not joined. What is specific here:
No click step: at 7/7 there is no incomplete step, so the orchestrator's
own initialiser leaves `activeStepId` null (useOnboardingOrchestrator:182)
and the panel already renders the flat list the board draws. This is the
one state where board and code agree on structure for free.
COMPLETED ROWS ARE NO LONGER FADED. `tw:opacity-55` on a done row was
drift from both boards — they draw those rows at full strength, with the
muted label and the filled box carrying 'done' — and it was a contrast
failure no instrument in this repo can see: measure.mjs reads the computed
`color` (#6B7280, 4.83:1 on white) and knows nothing about an ancestor's
opacity, while the pixels were #6B7280 at 55% over white, i.e. 2.1:1. At
7/7 that applied to the ENTIRE list. Removed; DESIGN.md already says tints
are never frame/alpha opacity.
NOT JOINED, and why:
296:2032 the checklist CARD — same padding/gap-vs-sections reason as the
4-of-7 recipe.
The board stops at the seventh row. The shipped panel then adds an
all-done footer ('You have completed all the getting started steps…' +
Close checklist) and turns the progress bar green. Both are additions
with no node to join, not drift — and the footer is the only way to put
a finished checklist away, so it is not a candidate for deletion either.
